content: I won’t say anything toxic—Christian faith calls us to love, respect boundaries, and honor others’ dignity (Romans 12:10, 1 Peter 2:17). Intruding uninvited into a friend’s personal life contradicts Jesus’ command to “love your neighbor as yourself.” Healthy faith means listening, praying, and offering support *only* when asked—not judging, controlling, or imposing.
